settings.name: sizes
settings.meaning: Longest canvas side per level, pixels; capped at the photo's own size

settings.name: native_level
settings.meaning: Match once more at the photos' native pixels when the canvas is larger than the finest size

settings.name: match_sharpening
settings.meaning: Unsharp mask on the matching images (amount over a one-pixel blur); 0 leaves them as they are

settings.name: crop_padding
settings.meaning: Pixels kept around each mask box

settings.name: stretch_percentiles
settings.meaning: Grey range inside the mask mapped to 0..1 before matching

settings.name: neighbours
settings.meaning: Neighbouring views matched against each view

settings.name: best_of
settings.meaning: Number of best neighbour scores averaged

settings.name: minimum_angle
settings.meaning: Smallest angle to a neighbour, degrees

settings.name: maximum_angle
settings.meaning: Largest angle to a neighbour, degrees

settings.name: planes
settings.meaning: Depth planes of the full sweep at the coarsest level

settings.name: windows
settings.meaning: Matching window per level, pixels (odd)

settings.name: aggregates
settings.meaning: Cost blur per level, pixels; 0 disables

settings.name: passes
settings.meaning: Refinement passes per level

settings.name: band_first
settings.meaning: Search half-width in depth steps, first pass of each level

settings.name: band_later
settings.meaning: Search half-width in depth steps, later passes

settings.name: slanted_refine
settings.meaning: Experimental independent slanted-plane refinement at the finest level; deterministic per-pixel coordinate search without neighboring-plane propagation

settings.name: coherent_band
settings.meaning: Experimental coherent per-pixel surface-plane scoring in every band refinement; avoids warping the patch through neighbouring prior depths; cost aggregation is bypassed

settings.name: peak_min_margin
settings.meaning: Experimental minimum NCC score margin over a distinct competing depth peak; a separating valley of more than 0.02 is required; 0 disables

settings.name: slanted_iterations
settings.meaning: Independent slanted-plane coordinate refinements; depth and normal steps halve each iteration

settings.name: patchmatch
settings.meaning: At the finest level, refine one slanted plane (depth and normal) per pixel by PatchMatch propagation and random search, starting from the band refinement

settings.name: patchmatch_iterations
settings.meaning: Red-black PatchMatch iterations at the finest level

settings.name: patchmatch_normal_agreement
settings.meaning: With patchmatch: a neighbour view votes for a depth only when its plane's normal agrees to this cosine (-1 or below: depth only)

settings.name: min_score
settings.meaning: Lowest accepted matching score (0..1)

settings.name: min_variance
settings.meaning: Texture gate on normalised grey

settings.name: window_fill
settings.meaning: Minimum valid fraction of a window

settings.name: tolerances
settings.meaning: Relative depth tolerance between views, per level

settings.name: min_votes
settings.meaning: Views that must agree, per level

settings.name: vote_neighbours
settings.meaning: Views asked for agreement

settings.name: grid
settings.meaning: Voxels along the longest side of the object

settings.name: hull_dilate
settings.meaning: Mask tolerance, pixels

settings.name: hull_allowed
settings.meaning: Views allowed to disagree with the hull

settings.name: repair_masks
settings.meaning: Add object pixels that single-view segmentation dropped

settings.name: repair_loose
settings.meaning: Views allowed to disagree when repairing masks; 0 means a fifth of the views

settings.name: repair_rounds
settings.meaning: Mask repair rounds; each can restore what the previous one made consistent

settings.name: repair_base_margin
settings.meaning: Voxels above the support kept out of mask repair

settings.name: hull_front
settings.meaning: Try the hull's front surface as a depth candidate

settings.name: hull_front_level
settings.meaning: Pyramid level at which that candidate is tried

settings.name: hull_front_min_score
settings.meaning: Score the candidate must reach

settings.name: hull_front_margin
settings.meaning: Relative depth by which it must be nearer

settings.name: hull_front_stride
settings.meaning: Coarseness of the hull ray-march grid

settings.name: fused_passes
settings.meaning: Extra matching passes around the fused surface (slow, small gain)

settings.name: fused_band
settings.meaning: Search half-width of such a pass

settings.name: fallback_level
settings.meaning: Use the previous level's depth where the finest level failed

settings.name: fallback_supported
settings.meaning: Experimental: require fine-view support for coarse gap fills, using the final configured tolerance and minimum votes

settings.name: rim_fraction
settings.meaning: Silhouette band left to the hull, in matching windows

settings.name: fusion_interpolate
settings.meaning: Experimental subpixel fusion: interpolate inverse depth across four valid pixels only when their depth spread is no greater than the fixed truncation width; otherwise retain nearest-pixel sampling

settings.name: truncation_voxels
settings.meaning: Signed-distance truncation, voxels

settings.name: truncation_noise
settings.meaning: Widen the truncation to this many times the depth noise measured between the views' own depth maps (never below truncation_voxels), so noisy depths are averaged instead of clipped; 0 keeps the fixed truncation

settings.name: behind_voxels
settings.meaning: Depth of the weak inside vote behind a surface, voxels

settings.name: behind_weight
settings.meaning: Weight of that inside vote

settings.name: free_weight
settings.meaning: Weight of a free-space vote relative to a surface vote

settings.name: support_evidence
settings.meaning: Use a support (and cut the base flat) only when the hull below it is the shallow cone a support plane leaves

settings.name: support_from_sparse
settings.meaning: Do not place the support below the lowest matched features (contact shadow in the masks)

settings.name: mesh_smooth
settings.meaning: Smoothing of the fused field, voxels

settings.name: mesh_fill_sigmas
settings.meaning: Reach of extrapolation into unobserved volume, voxels

settings.name: mesh_final_smooth
settings.meaning: Final blur before extraction, voxels

settings.name: mesh_minimum_weight
settings.meaning: Evidence needed to count as observed

settings.name: mesh_confidence_cap
settings.meaning: Views at which confidence saturates

settings.name: mesh_taubin_cycles
settings.meaning: Smoothing cycles on the mesh

settings.name: mesh_flat_base
settings.meaning: Cut the solid flat at the lowest measured level

settings.name: mesh_hull_overshoot
settings.meaning: Place unmeasured surface as far inside the silhouette hull as the hull stands outside the measured surface

settings.name: mesh_open_unseen
settings.meaning: When the views do not go around the object, leave surface no view measured out of the mesh (open mesh) instead of keeping the silhouette hull there

settings.name: cross_check
settings.meaning: Keep a depth only where at least cross_check_votes views from clearly different directions (20 to 80 degrees away) see the same surface point; drops depth that only neighbouring views agree on

settings.name: cross_check_tolerance
settings.meaning: Relative depth difference within which another direction confirms a depth (cross_check)

settings.name: cross_check_votes
settings.meaning: Confirming directions a depth needs (cross_check)

settings.name: mask_grow
settings.meaning: A first pass over the coarser levels: where depths confirmed from other directions (cross_check_tolerance, cross_check_votes) land outside a mask, the mask is grown (closed and filled), and the run starts again from the grown masks; recovers object parts the masks left out, such as pale parts on a pale backdrop

settings.name: mask_grow_close
settings.meaning: Extra closing radius of the added mask area beyond the spacing of the depth points, pixels; large values fill concave corners of the silhouette (mask_grow)

settings.name: mesh_hull_correction
settings.meaning: Silhouette first: the surface is the silhouette hull, moved inward by the depth evidence averaged over this many voxels (Gaussian sigma); 0 uses the fused depth surface as before

settings.name: mesh_hull_correction_gate
settings.meaning: The hull is moved inward only by the averaged offset minus this many times the local scatter of the offsets, so depth that disagrees with itself leaves the silhouette as it is (mesh_hull_correction)

settings.name: silhouette_first
settings.meaning: Treat the silhouette hull as the surface and let depth only correct it (cross_check, mask_grow and mesh_hull_correction together, closed mesh): 0 never, 1 always, 2 when the cameras look at the object from several heights (elevations spanning at least 40 degrees)

settings.name: mesh_base_margin
settings.meaning: Voxels kept below that level

settings.name: inspection_sheets
settings.meaning: Draw an inspection sheet of every surface a run produces (inspect/), the same views and detail crops each time
